app.name: PlantPulse
app.tagline: Care for your plants with a little help from AI
app.footer: © {{year}} PlantPulse. Plant care advice is informational only.

home.title: Your plants, alive and talking.
home.subtitle: Take a photo and PlantPulse's AI identifies your plant, checks its health and gives it a face. If you forget to water it, you will see it in its mood.
home.heroPetLabel: A happy cartoon plant in a pot

photo.title: Snap a photo
photo.body: Use your camera or upload a picture of any houseplant.

meet.title: Meet your plant
meet.body: AI identifies the species and builds a character with its own leaves.

care.title: Keep it happy
care.body: Water it, give it light and food. Real care in real life keeps it smiling.

home.moodsTitle: A plant that shows how it feels
home.moodsSubtitle: Its mood changes with the care you give it and with the health the AI sees in each check-up.

dashboard.title: My plants
dashboard.emptyBody: Add your first plant with a photo and meet its character.

addPlant.title: Add a plant
addPlant.intro: Take or upload a clear photo of the plant. The AI will identify it and check its health.
addPlant.namePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the identified name

photo.previewAlt: Preview of the selected plant photo
photo.cameraError: We couldn't access the camera. You can upload a photo instead.

plant.deleteBody: The plant, its photos and its history will be permanently removed.

analysis.title: Plant analysis
analysis.disclaimer: AI analysis is informational and can be wrong. It does not replace the advice of a plant specialist.

checkup.title: Health check-up
checkup.intro: Upload a new photo to see how your plant is doing today.

settings.title: Account
settings.deleteBody: Deleting your account permanently removes your plants, photos and data.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. All your plants and photos will be erased.

notFound.title: This page wilted away
notFound.body: The page you are looking for doesn't exist.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.validationFailed: Please check the information you entered.
errors.invalidCareType: That care action is not valid.
errors.emailAlreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.invalidRefreshToken: Your session expired. Please log in again.
errors.invalidImage: That file is not a valid image. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.fileTooLarge: The photo is too large. Try a smaller one.
errors.notAPlant: We couldn't see a plant in that photo. Try a clearer picture.
errors.aiResponseInvalid: The AI gave an unexpected answer. Please try again.
errors.aiProviderUnavailable: The AI service is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.aiQuotaExceeded: You reached today's limit of AI analyses. Try again tomorrow.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.

pet.title: {{name}}'s care
pet.characterLabel: {{name}} looks {{mood}}. Tap to make it bounce.
pet.error: We couldn't reach your plant. Check your connection and try again.
pet.disclaimer: Care tips are general guidance and do not replace advice from a plant specialist.

message.happy: I feel great today! Thanks for taking care of me.
message.sick: I don't feel well... maybe a photo check-up would help?

low.water: I'm getting a bit thirsty. Could I have some water?
low.fertilize: My soil could use some nutrients.

critical.water: I'm so thirsty! Please water me!
critical.sun: It's so dark here... I need sunlight!
critical.fertilize: I'm starving for nutrients. Please feed me!
